name: ClickHouse Agent Skills
summary: Official Apache-2.0 Agent Skills pack for ClickHouse, ClickHouse Cloud, chDB, Postgres infra and ClickStack.
description: ClickHouse/agent-skills is the official Agent Skills pack for ClickHouse and ClickHouse Cloud. Official LICENSE is Apache License 2.0. The repository is not archived; created 2026-01-15 and last pushed 2026-11-19T19:42:08Z (2026-11-19 20:42:08 Europe/Stockholm). Official README lists eight skills: clickhouse-best-practices (36 rules covering schema design, query optimization, native full-text search, and data ingestion), clickhouse-architecture-advisor (5 decision frameworks for workload-aware architecture decisions for real-time ClickHouse deployments), clickhouse-js-node-troubleshooting, chdb-datastore, chdb-sql, infra-clickhouse (local and cloud workflows for running ClickHouse with clickhousectl), infra-postgres (local Docker-backed Postgres and managed ClickHouse Cloud Postgres services, described as beta), and clickstack-otel-collector (OpenTelemetry Collector wiring for Managed ClickStack). Documented installs (`npx skills add clickhouse/agent-skills` and `clickhousectl skills`) were not executed. ClickHouse Cloud usage is separate and was not purchased. This pack is distinct from the already catalogued clickhouse-mcp-server.

agent_access.notes: Public Apache-2.0 GitHub pack. No hosted MCP endpoint is documented on this repository. Documented npx and clickhousectl skill installs were not executed. ClickHouse Cloud usage is separate and was not purchased.
